item.title: Former Netflix/Spotify exec Chris Whiteley joins Apple as country director
item.description: Former Spotify and Netflix exec Chris Whiteley has joined Apple as country director for content and services.

item.title: Doc Sentinels of Antarctica finds buyers as Only Distrib reveals factual slate sales
item.description: Irish public broadcaster TG4 and Canal+ Group-owned channel and content distributor Thema have both acquired documentary Sentinels of Antarctica.

item.title: Germany’s Beta Film boards royal romance drama series Queen Silvia
item.description: Germany’s Beta Film has boarded upcoming royal love story drama Queen Silvia, a 6x60’ coproduction with Pyjama Pictures and Sweden’s Unlimited Stories for Prime Video in the DACH region and Sat.1 in Germany.

item.title: HBO Max strikes first-look deal with ex-Movistar Plus+ content chief Domingo Corral
item.description: SERIES MANIA: Global streamer HBO Max has agreed a first-look deal with Domingo Corral, the former content director at Movistar Plus+.

item.title: Cartoon Network’s Saud Boksmati named creative chief at Canada’s ForgeVision
item.description: Former Cartoon Network executive Saud Boksmati has been appointed co-founder and chief creative officer at Canadian software development company ForgeVision Technologies.

item.title: TV Globo enters Underground City in documentary series from Endemol Shine Brasil
item.description: Brazil’s TV Globo has ordered a docu-reality series offering an immersive look into São Paulo’s subway system.

item.title: Meevee preps preschool streaming platform designed to wean kids off screens
item.description: Amsterdam-based children’s media company Meevee is launching a streaming platform later this month that is designed to curb endless screen time.

item.title: Social video advertising to drive global TV and video revenues to $1tn by 2030, says Omdia
